scope: Frozen-checkpoint inference-state experiment, not training/weight-forgetting ablation
models: Three seeds x two training orders; sparse 168x4 MLP, 196 pixels/branch, original hard supervised-trace training

policies.magnitude: EMA of previous images magnitude-soft branch weights
policies.pseudo: EMA branch preferences from counterfactual CE against own prediction; no labels
policies.supervised: Matched EMA branch preferences from true-label counterfactual CE, explicit postprediction-feedback control

preferences: Counterfactual errors relative to stateless prediction; standardize within each neuron then softmax(-error). Fixed probes; not recomputed for state-conditioned prediction.
selection: Choose each state policy by mean validation accuracy on persistent-context stream over six checkpoints; no test tuning
streams: All images once: persistent context rotates blocks of 200 within digit pair, or random mixed stream; no boundaries passed to algorithm
causality: Predict current image before adding its observation. Only supervised feedback control receives true labels after prediction.
limits: Pretrained checkpoint architecture previously selected on same validation pool; exploratory secondary evaluation. Labels only construct benchmark streams, metrics, and explicit supervised control. No task-ID input, no prototypes, no query-label input to label-free policies. State resets only at start of independent streams except specified intervention.
